cards.title: Growing revenue?
cards.body: Where will your next revenue stream come from? We help industrial and B2B companies unlock new revenue from existing products, customers and operations.

cards.title: Improving customer experience?
cards.body: What if your customers loved doing business with you? We design experiences that drive loyalty, reduce churn, and make your brand the easy choice.

cards.title: Launching new products?
cards.body: What if you had the team to finally build that product? Whether it's been stuck on your roadmap for months or years, we provide the design and engineering expertise to take it from concept to launch.

sections.text: We are a studio of designers and engineers helping companies navigate a rapidly changing world. We work across AI, digital products, new ventures and organisational change to solve complex business challenges.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: A product design and engineering studio helping B2B companies launch digital products, services and new ventures.

cards.title: Expert Consultants
cards.body: Need additional capability? Bring in experienced designers, software engineers and product specialists who can strengthen your team from day one.

cards.title: Project Team
cards.body: Need something built? A cross-functional Humblebee team takes ownership. From strategy and design to engineering and launch.

cards.title: CoVenture Team
cards.body: Looking for your next advantage? Partner with us to discover, validate and launch new ventures with shared ambition and shared commitment.

sections.heading: Are you more AI-ready than your competitors?
sections.body: The AI Readiness Report benchmarks your business, identifies where AI can have the biggest impact, and puts a value on each opportunity. It's free for selected companies during launch.
